patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.chiefComplaint: Can't see out of one eye
presentation.quote: It's been like this since about noon. Total blackness on the left side. My mate says it's obvious what the problem is, but he's been drinking since eleven so I don't trust him.
presentation.triageNote: 41-year-old male in a pirate costume reporting loss of vision in the left eye; vision is entirely normal once the costume eye patch is lifted, with a normal eye examination.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because vision is normal once the costume patch is lifted and no emergency resource is required.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has no ocular pathology; the reported visual loss is caused by an opaque costume patch.
clinical.acuityReason: Vision is normal once the costume patch is lifted and no emergency resource is required.
teachingPoints: Sudden monocular vision loss is a genuine emergency and deserves the full workup — which begins with actually looking at the eye. Lift the patch before you order anything.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleDiagnoses: Vision obscured by a costume patch
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: A complete basic eye examination and reassurance would allow discharge without testing.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting forward earnestly, gesturing toward his patched eye

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 41-year-old man in a full pirate costume with a black eye patch over his left eye and a tricorn pirate hat, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting forward earnestly, gesturing toward his patched eye. Expression: genuinely concerned and completely sincere. Clearly visible: a black costume eye patch over the left eye; full pirate costume with a wide-sleeved shirt and sash. Overall: entirely well. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
